The '''Nepton power core''' was a [[Power core/Legends|power core]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. Nepton power cores were installed aboard SoroSuub's [[Nestt-class light freighter|''Nestt''-class light freighters]].
